repos.description: Local security audit for AI API relays and LLM proxies: detects prompt injection, model substitution, tool-call rewriting, SSE anomalies, error leakage, and Web3 wallet risks.
Open Source Reliability Harness: Make your agents follow rules. One line of code to‎ ‎enforce, trace, and improve. ‎ ‎

Static analysis for AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts — catches vague tool descriptions, missing stop conditions, and schema gaps before they reach runtime. Zero-LLM, deterministic checks, built for CI.
